display_long_description:
CuriosityXR brings an AI guide into your room. Ask a question out loud and explore the answer through spoken explanations, images, and interactive 3D models.

Try asking about the human body, planets, animals, machines, geography, history, or anything else you are curious about. When a relevant model is available, it appears in your space for you to grab, rotate, and resize.

Keep the conversation going with follow-up questions. Use hand tracking for a natural mixed reality experience, or explore with your Touch controllers.

CuriosityXR is made for curious people, visual learners, families, students, and teachers. It is a different way to explore ideas, whether you are studying something specific or simply wondering how the world works.

CuriosityXR works on Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest 2, and Quest Pro. Quest 3 and Quest 3S support color passthrough, allowing models to appear in your real room.

English and an internet connection are currently required.
CuriosityXR grew from peer-reviewed research published at IEEE VR and IEEE AIxVR.

One purchase. No recurring subscription.
